posts.cooked:
So after La Capitán's poor showing, let's try another villain. Spiff's randomizer gave us:

  • Plague Rat

​vs

  • The Sentinels (grysqrl)
  • Chrono-Ranger (Matchstickman)
  • Ra: Horus of Two Horizons (PlatinumWarlock)
  • Tempest (Humble-Knight)
  • Parse (Oaktree)

​in

  • Freedom Tower

​Plague Rat snuck in through the sewers to the Freedom Tower while the Freedom Five were off on Mars! Can the visiting heroes save the day?

EDIT: Almost full! EDIT #2: And we're off!
